<a2ui>
surface("flashcard-study-surface")

$/vocab/reviewed_count = 0
$/vocab/total_count = 10

header = page_header(
    title="Vocabulary Flashcards",
    subtitle="Flip through the cards to test your knowledge and track your progress.",
    icon="📚",
    tag="Study Mode",
    accent="#4f46e5"
)

progress = progress_bar(
    value=40,
    label="Cards Reviewed",
    accent="#4f46e5",
    show_percent=true,
    caption="4 of 10 cards reviewed"
)

deck = flashcard_deck(
    cards=[
        {front: "Ephemeral", back: "Lasting for a very short time."},
        {front: "Serendipity", back: "Finding valuable things by chance rather than design."},
        {front: "Mellifluous", back: "Sweet or musical; pleasant to hear."},
        {front: "Petrichor", back: "A pleasant smell that frequently accompanies the first rain after a long period of warm, dry weather."},
        {front: "Ineffable", back: "Too great or extreme to be expressed or described in words."},
        {front: "Cynosure", back: "A person or thing that is the center of attention."},
        {front: "Lethologica", back: "The inability to remember a particular word you want to use."},
        {front: "Nebulous", back: "Inclearly defined, hazy, or vague."},
        {front: "Panacea", back: "A solution or remedy for all difficulties or diseases."},
        {front: "Sempiternal", back: "Eternal and unchanging; everlasting."}
    ],
    accent="#4f46e5",
    label_front="TERM",
    label_back="DEFINITION"
)

root = columns(
    cols=1,
    gap="1.5rem",
    items=[
        {blocks: [header]},
        {blocks: [progress]},
        {blocks: [deck]}
    ]
)
</a2ui>
